description: Gold set for Phase 6 retrieval: 40 questions written before any tuning. A question passes (recall at 5) when at least one relevant passage is among the top 5 results. 'relevant' lists alternatives (any one is enough). Regulation passages are matched by article (and paragraph when given), document passages by source file and heading. 'filters.system' is an estate system id; 'filters.doc_type' is a document type.
